name: Hardstyle Plank
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank, elbows under shoulders.
Actively pull your elbows toward your toes and your toes toward your elbows to create full-body tension.
Squeeze the glutes hard and brace the abs as if for a punch.
Breathe shallowly behind the brace and hold 10-20 seconds — tension matters more than duration.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Hardstyle Plank builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
